channel.title: Ableton Live Mastery
channel.description: A device-by-device walking-podcast deep-dive into Ableton Live's instruments, effects, and Max for Live. Each episode pairs a device's history and synthesis theory with patch-walkthroughs and IDM-style production techniques. Hosted by a sardonic studio rat who reads Tape Op and refuses to use the word "journey."
